_about: Hand-read conclusions per kind (docs/smash-run-enemies/README.md, 'hand_read'), from the generated specs and the ARM they come from (3DS enemy_fs.cro, update). Copied by tools/s3ds_enemy_spec.py into <kind>.json as 'hand_read' and into <kind>.md as 'Reading'. States are the 3DS state ids (the state table index). 'inferred' marks what the code does not say outright. Param refs: P<g>[entry].field = the kind's fs vl, group g in the reader's order (P1 = search params, P2 = the attack list); P@0xNN / PSnn.fK = scalar / inline-struct members at that offset of the param object.

kuribo.summary: Goomba. Walks (no hitbox); every 100 frames looks for a fighter in a box ahead; on seeing one it does a little surprised back-hop, then charges (RunL) with a contact hitbox for up to 110 frames, turning to keep chasing; then brakes and walks again. Stomped -> Collapses (squashed); killed -> flies off as a bullet that hits.
kuribo.variations: var 1 turns at ledges (walk, run, brake); every other variation walks / runs off ledges. P0 has one entry (no per-variation tuning).

states.1: Fall: Fall (loop), kinetic 8, ground attach off. On ground -> 2 (interrupt).
states.2: Landing: Landing, kinetic 0, attach on. Motion end -> 3.
states.3: Walk: WalkL (loop) at rate P0.f5 = 0.6 (written to MotionModule +0x50), kinetic 10, attach on. No hitbox. Every P1[0].interval = 100 frames (state frame counter this+0x16c: reset by slot 54, +1 per frame by slot 55) search_target-style check_target(type 2, box (100, 40), offset (10, 10)); a target found -> face it (reverse_lr when the target's x is behind) and -> 4 (interrupt). Off ground -> 1. On ground: ledge ahead and var == 1 -> reverse_lr + re-enter 3; else wall ahead (GroundModule is_touch(lr > 0 ? 4 : 2)) -> reverse_lr + re-enter 3.
states.4: Notice hop: x hop speed = P0.f7 = -0.4 (backwards) written to the energy +0x20, 0 if check_cliff_distance_lr(f7 * (f8 / gl[+0x120] + 2) * -2, -lr) finds a ledge behind; kinetic 5 (jump), attach off, RunHoldL (loop), play_se(0x28D0002). Update: while airborne (this+0x179 = 1) waits for y speed <= 0 and ground -> attach on; then after state frame > P0.f11 = 30 -> 5.
states.5: Charge: RunL (loop) at rate P0.f10 = 1.0, kinetic 10, attach on. ATTACK ARMED (P2 entry 0). Frame counter this+0x170 +1 per frame; every P1[1].interval = 60 frames check_target(type 2, box (150, 60), offset (0, 10)): target behind -> 7 (turn). Off ground -> 1; ledge ahead: var 1 -> clear_speed_all and -> 7, others keep running off; wall ahead -> 7. this+0x170 > P0.f12 = 110 -> 6 (brake).
states.6: Brake: RunBrakeL, kinetic 2, attach on. var != 1: off ground -> 1. var 1: ledge -> clear_speed_all. Motion end -> 3.
states.7: Run turn: RunTurnL, kinetic 2. Ledge -> clear_speed_all. Motion end -> reverse_lr(1,1), then -> 5 if the state before the turn was 5 (this+0x168, saved by the change_state wrappers when leaving 5 or entering 3), else -> 3.
states.8: Collapses (stomped, from slot 21 = notify_on_tread, inferred): kinetic 0, Collapses, attach on, notify_on_death, play_se(0x28D0004); on state frame == P0.f14 = 1 create_dead_item(1, 10, 0, 0); motion end -> 10.
states.9: Death flight (slot 67 death_state = 9): Damage pose at rate 0, bullet() (the framework launches the body); ATTACK ARMED (P2 entry 1). When the kinetic module's flag 8 is set (the flight ended) -> 10.

danger.source: param P2 entry 0 (framework set_attack_data on entering state 5)
danger.note: the only time a live Goomba hurts: while charging (RunL). Not while walking.

kuribo.targeting: start (slot 41): faces get_nearest_target. Walk / charge use EnemyAiModule::check_target with param group 1 entries 0 / 1 (type 2) on a frame-modulo timer; the found fighter's x decides the turn.
kuribo.kinetics: initialize (slot 40) writes the AI energy [[[acc+0x30B0]+8]+0]+4: +0x08 = P0.f1 2.0, +0x0C = f2 1.5, +0x10 = f4 0.02, +0x14 = f6 0.001, +0x18 = f3 0.01, +0x20 = f7 -0.4, +0x24 = f8 1.6, +0x2C = f9 5, +0x40 = 1, +0x44 = f13 0.8, then the energy's vslot 31 (0x20000004, 5.0, 1.0). Field meanings unresolved (copy them as is: the Wii U energy has the same layout). Walk and run use the same kinetic (10) and differ in motion rate (0.6 / 1.0).
kuribo.death: HP 0 -> state 9 (bullet flight, hits) -> 10 remove; stomped -> 8 (Collapses, drops a dead item) -> 10.
kuribo.meshes: no vmt; the face is a material animation (material_anime) on the 3DS.

heiho.summary: Shy Guy. Waits and walks about at random; when a fighter is found it hops twice in place, pauses, then runs at it with a contact hitbox for a while (turning back if passed), brakes and walks again. Hops over walls it can climb.
heiho.variations: 4 variations (P0 has 3 rows per variation: walk / notice hop / run). var 1 and 2 stop at ledges while walking (var 0 and 3 walk off); var 0 attack power x2 (P6[var].f0, applied by set_attack_power after every change_state into 9 or 15); the colour is the material animation frame var * 10 at rate 0 (start). The enemy's HP is scaled by FieldSmashAdjustDifficulty::get_enemy_hp_mul (start).

states.1: Fall: kinetic 8, attach off, Fall (loop). Vertical speed <= 0 and on ground -> 2.
states.2: Landing: kinetic 0, attach on, Landing. Motion end: if facing away from the nearest target (check_turn_to_target) -> 5 (turn) else -> 4.
states.3: Wait: kinetic 2, Wait. Wait plays twice (this+0x17c counts motion ends); then 50% (random_range(1,100) <= 50) reverse_lr, -> 4. Every search_interval(0) frames search_target(0): found -> face it -> 7. Off ground -> 1.
states.4: Walk: energy +0x08 / +0x10 = P0[var*3].f1 (0.3, var 3: 0.5), +0x14 = f2, +0x20 / +0x28 = f5 0.5, +0x24 / +0x2C = f6 (2.5 / 2.2); kinetic 1, attach on, Walk (loop); walk time this+0x170 = random_range(P0.f3 60, P0.f4 120). Update: move(stick = lr). Wall -> 6. var 1/2: ledge -> move(0) and -> 5. Timer out -> 3. Every search_interval(0) frames search_target(0): found -> face -> 7. Off ground -> 1.
states.5: Turn: kinetic 0, Turn. Motion end -> reverse_lr; -> 9 if the run timer this+0x174 is still running, else -> 4.
states.6: Wall hop: kinetic 5, attach off, Walk, play_se(0x69B0002), start y saved. Landing: if it rose more than P@0x90 = 0.5 and ray_check finds no wall -> 2, else -> 5 (turn back).
states.7: Notice hop: set_kinetic_jump(0, P0[var*3+1].f6 (2 / 2 / 2.5 / 2), 0, 1), attach off, RunHold (loop), play_se(0x69B0002); this+0x17c = 1; each landing with this+0x17c < 2 hops again (kinetic 5, sound); the second landing -> 8.
states.8: Pause: kinetic 0, RunHold, timer = P0[var*3+1].f4 (0 / 60 / 60 / 60). Timer out -> face the found target -> 9.
states.9: Run: energy from P0[var*3+2] (+0x08 / +0x10 = 0.8, var 3: 1.0, ...), kinetic 3, attach on, Run (loop). ATTACK ARMED (P2 entry 0, power x P6[var].f0). Run timer this+0x174 = P0[var*3+2].f4 (120 / 80 / ...) when not already running. Timer out -> 12. Wall: var 1/2 check_wall_jump_or_turn -> 6 (hop) else -> 10 (turn); ledge (var 1/2 only) -> move(0), -> 10. Every search_interval(1) frames search_target(1): target behind -> 13. Off ground -> 1 (run timer cleared).
states.10: Run turn: kinetic 0, RunTurn; ledge -> clear_speed_x; motion end -> reverse_lr -> 9.
states.11: Run wall hop: as 6 with Run; landing -> 2 or 10.
states.12: Brake: kinetic 2, RunBrake; motion end and stopped -> 14.
states.13: Chase turn: kinetic 2, RunTurn at rate 0.7 (PS78-type member); motion end -> reverse_lr -> 9.
states.14: Recover: kinetic 21, attach off, Fall (loop); when the kinetic module's flag 1 is set -> 4.
states.15: Death flight (death_state 15): DamageStart at rate 0, bullet(); ATTACK ARMED (P2 entry 1). Flag 8 -> 16.

danger.source: param P2 entry 0, power x P6[var].f0 (var 0: x2)
danger.note: only while running at a target (state 9). Not while waiting, walking, hopping or turning.

heiho.targeting: search_interval(i) = P1[i].interval, search_target(i) = check_target(P1[i].search_type, this+0x14, range / offset from P1[i]) (code.bin 0x9EA658). Index 0 while waiting / walking, 1 while running.
heiho.meshes: no vmt (colour by material animation frame).

waddledee.summary: Waddle Dee. Walks, sometimes jumps (random, and at walls), turns at walls / ledges. Never targets anyone and has no contact hitbox: only its defeated body (bullet) and its dropped parasol hurt. Parasol variations float down slowly with the parasol open.
waddledee.variations: var 0 / 1 carry a parasol (fall with ParasolFall through the EnemyAerialModule; the parasol meshes follow lr; when hit / killed the parasol is dropped as the article 'waddledee_parasol' and var becomes var + 2); var 2 / 3 have none. Ledge turning: var 1 and 3 only (0 and 2 walk off).

states.1: Fall: kinetic 8, attach off, Fall (loop). On ground -> 3 (interrupt).
states.2: Parasol fall (var 0/1): EnemyAerialModule set_mode_normal(accel P0.f6 0.0005, max 10, 10), current speed (x kept, y = -P0.f5 0.2), ParasolFall (loop); aerial update with stick lr each frame. On ground -> 3.
states.4: Walk: kinetic 1, attach on, Walk (loop) at rate PS78.f3 = 1.2 (struct at +0x78: 100 50 50 1.2). Update move(lr). Every PS78.f0 = 100 frames: random_range(1,100) <= PS78.f1 = 50 -> 6 (jump). Wall: random_range(1,100) > PS78.f2 = 50 -> 5 (turn) else -> 6 (jump). var 1/3: ledge -> 5. Off ground -> 1 (var 2/3) or 2 (var 0/1).
states.5: Turn: kinetic 0, Turn. Motion end -> reverse_lr -> 4 (interrupt).
states.6: Jump: kinetic 5, attach off, Jump. Vertical speed <= 0 -> 1 / 2.
states.7: Death flight (death_state 7): Damage at rate 0, bullet(); ATTACK ARMED (P2 entry 0); damage face shown. Flag 8 -> 8.

danger.states: parasol dropped (var 0/1 when hit or killed: slots 13, 69, 71 -> L5cf90 generate_article(0))
danger.note: article attack fields id 0, part 0, node 2001 (inferred: the weapon's own node)

waddledee.targeting: none (no search calls): it faces the nearest fighter only at start.
waddledee.projectiles: article 0 = weapon kind 0xB0-range id from enemy_article_data_set_waddledee: the parasol (dropped, not shot).
waddledee.death: HP 0 -> 7 (bullet, damage face) -> 8 remove; the parasol is dropped first (notify_on_death -> L5cf90).
waddledee.meshes: vmt: 0 Cparasol, 1 Larm, 2 Lparasol, 3 Rarm, 4 Rparasol, 5 damage, 6 normal. L5d04c (every state enter): var 2/3 (no parasol): Larm/Rarm on, parasols off, normal face (damage off). var 0/1: Cparasol on while ParasolFall (motion 11) and both arms off; otherwise the parasol in the hand on the side given by lr (Lparasol + Rarm, or Rparasol + Larm) and node scale squash (slots 21 / 55). Death (L5cf18): both arms, no parasol, damage face on, normal off.

waddledoo.summary: Waddle Doo. Walks, randomly jumps, turns at walls; every so often searches; on finding a fighter it charges (BeamShotHold) and sweeps its beam (articles 'waddledoo_beam' fired in a fan). No contact hitbox. Leaves (despawns) after 600 frames of walking.

states.1: Fall: kinetic 8, Fall. On ground -> 2. While falling it can still search (search_interval(1)) -> 7.
states.2: Landing: Landing; motion end: face away from nearest -> 4 else -> 3.
states.3: Walk: kinetic 1, attach on, Walk (loop); life timer this+0x184 (start = PS8c.f0 = 600) counts down -> 9 (leave). Wall -> 5. Every PS8c.f1 = 60 frames random_range(1,100) <= PS8c.f2 = 50 -> 6 (jump). search_interval(1) / search_target(1) with a cooldown this+0x180: found -> life timer reset to 600, -> 7. search_interval(0) / search_target(0): found and facing away -> 4.
states.4: Turn: kinetic 0, Turn; motion end -> reverse_lr -> 3.
states.5: Wall jump: kinetic 5, Jump, then Fall (set_motion_no_restart) when falling; landing: rose more than P@0xC0 = 0.5 and no wall -> 3 else -> 4. Can search -> 7.
states.6: Jump: kinetic 5, Jump / Fall; landing -> 3. Can search -> 7.
states.7: Beam charge: (on ground: kinetic 0, attach) BeamShotHold at rate PS8c.f3 = 1; motion end -> 8.
states.8: Beam: BeamShot at rate PS8c.f4 = 4; shots = 180 / PS8c.f9 (25) = 7 (this+0x17c), one every PS8c.f8 = 2 frames: generate_article_angle(0, (30 - 25 * n) * lr) (a fan from +30 down to -120 degrees); play_se(0x6A80000) looped, stopped on exit. All shot and motion end -> 3.
states.9: Leave: Fall at rate 0, init_common_leave(P6) / update_common_leave; done -> 11.
states.10: Death flight (death_state 10): Damage at rate 0, bullet(); ATTACK ARMED (P2 entry 0). Flag 8 -> 11.

danger.source: weapon waddledoo_beam (article 0), its attack from P7 (elem 0xa4, read by WeaponSpecializer_EnemyWaddledooBeam 0xA407C)
danger.note: each beam segment: speed PSc4.f1 = 4 along its angle, life PSc4.f0 = 8 frames (inferred), effect scale PSc4.f2 = 0.5; the WeaponSpecializer sets the attack with id f0, part f1, size f8

waddledoo.targeting: two searches: index 1 (P1[1]: interval 20, box (60, 70), offset (30, 20)) gates the beam; index 0 (P1[0]: interval 60, box (200, 200)) only turns it to face.
waddledoo.projectiles: waddledoo_beam (weapon kind 175 in enemy_article_data_set_waddledoo, max 5 alive (inferred from the entry's second word)).
waddledoo.meshes: vmt: 0 eye_blink1, 1 eye_blink2, 2 eye_normal, 3 tear. Slot 55 (every frame) while walking (state 3) blinks: normal eye, then blink2, blink1 (PS8c.f12 = 4 frames each) at random intervals random_range(PS8c.f10 30, f11 50); tear shown in state 10 (death) and from slots 56/57; otherwise eye_normal on, the rest off.

churine.summary: Churine (Kid Icarus). Walks, turns at walls and ledges; when it finds a fighter it hops toward it and puffs sleep powder (ACMD hitboxes) for a while. No contact hitbox while walking.

states.2: Landing: Landing; motion end: after a wall hop (this+0x178) or facing away from the nearest target -> 5 (turn), else -> 3.
states.3: Walk: initialize() (re-writes the energy), kinetic 1, attach on, Walk (loop). Wall -> 4 (hop over); ledge -> 5 (turn). Search: every search_interval(0) frames (countdown this+0x168) search_target(0): found -> 6 (if it must turn first, this+0x170 = 1 and -> 5). A first-frame flag this+0x171 (set at start) -> 6 once.
states.4: Wall hop: kinetic 5, Jump; landing higher than P0.f6 = 20 with no wall -> 2 (this+0x178 = 1), else -> 5.
states.5: Turn: kinetic 0, Turn; motion end -> reverse_lr -> 6 if a target was pending (this+0x170) else -> 3.
states.6: Attack hop: clear speed, energy +0x20 = 0, +0x24 = P0.f9 = 1, +0x28 / +0x2C = 10, +0x1C = 0; kinetic 5, Jump; move(lr, 1); landing -> 7.
states.7: Sleep powder: kinetic 0, SleepPowder. ACMD (attack.bin, SleepPowder) arms the hitboxes (below). From state frame P0.f12 = 40 request_follow_effect(0x71F0000, ...) at rate P0.f10 = 1.4, scale P0.f11 = 1, play_se(0x6B00001); when the effect ends -> 5 and the search cooldown this+0x16c = P0.f13 = 210. Off ground -> 1.
states.8: Death flight (death_state 8): DamageStart at rate 0, bullet(); ATTACK ARMED (P2 entry 0). Flag 8 -> 9.

danger.hitboxes: frame 50: id 1, part 0, bone 2, damage 1.0, angle 361, kbg 7, size 8.0, offset (0, 4, 11), effect 9; frame 70: id 2, bone 2, damage 1.0, angle 361, kbg 3, size 25.0, offset (0, 4, 40); removed at frame 125
danger.note: the sleep cloud (the effect 9 field = sleep, inferred); the article churine_sleeppowder exists in the CRO but this behaviour uses an effect + ACMD hitboxes instead (no generate_article call).

churine.projectiles: none fired by code (effect 0x71F0000 + ACMD hitboxes).
churine.death: HP 0 -> 8 (bullet) -> 9; the powder effect is removed (slot 69 / state 8 enter).

zima.summary: Zoomer (Metroid). Crawls along floors, walls and ceilings (EnemyGroundLineTraceModule) with a contact hitbox all the time, sometimes reversing at corners; falls when it loses the surface.

states.1: Fall: kinetic 8, Wait (loop), passable check off; helper L668d4 arms the contact attack (P2 entry 0). On ground -> 2.
states.2: Landed: kinetic 0; faces the nearest target first (-> 5 = turn) unless already done (this+0x25C), then -> 4.
states.3: Wait (after damage, slot 64): Wait; on ground -> 4, else -> 1.
states.4: Crawl: kinetic 26, attach off, Move (loop), setup_trace; corner timer random_range(PS78.f1 100, f2 200); helper L668d4 (contact attack). Update: trace update; on ground or wall: at a corner (can_turn_over) when the timer runs out, success_by_percent(PS78.f3 = 50) -> reverse_lr + reset_speed; the model is rotated to the surface normal (calc_angle, set_node_rotate) and the attack vector follows. Lost the surface -> end_trace, -> 1.
states.6: Death flight (death_state 6): DamageStart at rate 0, bullet(); its own set_attack_data (slot 45) arms P2 entry 1 for state 6.

danger.source: param P2 entry 0, armed by helper L668d4 (AttackModule clear + create_attack_data(P2[0]) + set_attack) in states 1 and 4, kept (slot 45 is overridden: it only clears / sets entries >= 1)

zima.targeting: only faces the nearest target on landing.

plasmawisp.summary: Plasma Wisp. Floats toward a target point (EnemyAerialModule homing) and, depending on its charge level, shoots needles (5 in a row, the last a bigger one), a laser or a cannon shot (articles). Contact hitbox while floating; it grows its attack with its level (this+0x1E8).

states.1: Death flight (death_state 1): DamageStart at rate 0, bullet(), set_lr(1); its slot 45 arms P2 entry 3 (power 12). Flag 8 -> 10.
states.2: Float: kinetic 26, attach off, passable, Float (loop). search_interval(0) / search_target(0) -> aerial set_target_point(target); facing away -> 3. Level timer (this+0x1F0 vs this+0x1F4) raises the level (L898d8: re-arms the contact attack for the level). search_interval(1) / search_target(1) then by level: 0 -> 4 (needles) when the target is within PS78.f5 = 50 (random), 1 -> 6 (laser), 2 -> 8 (cannon).
states.3: Air turn: AirTurn; motion end -> reverse_lr -> 2.
states.4: Needle charge: NeedleHold at PS78.f12 = 0.5, effect 0x7120007 at joint 3, se 0x6A20000; each motion end: shot n (this+0x1F8): generate_article_angle(0 (needle), lr * -90), the 5th: article 1 (large needle) -> 5; NeedleHold again at rate PS78.f13 = 2.
states.6: Laser charge: LaserHold at PS78.f14 = 0.9, effect 0x7120008; motion end: generate_article_angle(2 (laser), lr * -90), se 0x6A20002 -> 7.
states.8: Cannon charge: CannonHold at PS78.f15 = 0.9, effect 0x7120009; motion end: generate_article_angle(3 (hadoudan), ...), se 0x6A20003 -> 9.

danger.source: param P2 entries 0 / 1 / 2 (state 2), by level: slot 45 arms entry 0 on entering 2; L898d8 / L5cc54 re-arm with entry 'level' (create_attack_data(P2 + 0xA8 * level))
articles: needle / large needle (attack P6 entries 0 / 1: power 1, angle 361, size 1), laser (P7: power 3, angle 20, bkb 50, size 3), hadoudan (P8: power 9, angle 361, bkb 150, size 12)
danger.note: the P6 / P7 / P8 to article mapping is by order (inferred)

plasmawisp.targeting: search_target(0) picks the float target (aerial homing to its position), search_target(1) (P1[1]: interval 5, box (140, 20)) triggers the attacks.
plasmawisp.projectiles: enemy_article_data_set_plasmawisp: 4 articles = plasmawisp_needle, (large needle), plasmawisp_laser, plasmawisp_hadoudan (order by the generate_article indices 0-3; names inferred from the CRO's weapon classes: needle, laser, hadoudan). (inferred) The article entries: two of weapon kind 176 (needle; the second with a different data pointer = the large needle), then the laser and the hadoudan.

darios.summary: Darios (Kid Icarus Uprising). A ground turret: lands, slowly swivels its barrel (Turn motion frames set from the aim angle) toward a fighter inside its aim cone, charges (effect) and fires a sweeping beam that is an attack on the enemy itself (param P6, re-set every frame while the beam lasts), with screen shake; then cools down.
darios.variations: P0 rows are indexed by the variation (var * 9 words... per-variation tuning: charge P0.f6 = 90 frames, beam P0.f8 = 120 frames, ...).

states.1: Fall: kinetic 8; meshes default on, shoot off. On ground -> 2.
states.2: Settle: kinetic 4 (bounce) with a 100-frame timer, then kinetic 8; on ground -> 3.
states.3: Aim: kinetic 0, attach on. Turns the barrel toward search_target(0) / the nearest target (helper L645e0 drives the Turn motion frame from the angle, L645a0 = angle to the target); after P0.f3 = 10 frames search_target(1, ..., angle cone) with P1[1] (range (100, 30)) -> 4. Off ground -> 1.
states.4: Charge: kinetic 0; meshes default on, shoot off; follow effect 0x71D0002 at joint 3, play_se(0x6B20000); P0.f6 = 90 frames (barrel node 5 rotated each frame) -> 5. Off ground -> 1 (helper L643ac resets the barrel).
states.5: Beam: meshes default off, shoot on; effects 0x71D0000 (scale P0.f13 = 1.5) and 0x71D0001, play_se(0x6B20001), ShakeModule req for P0.f8 = 120 frames. Every frame: create_attack_data(P6[...]) + AttackModule set_attack(0, 0): the beam hitbox; the barrel tracks the nearest target once (after P0.f18 = 20 frames); beam nodes 3 / 6 translated (length grows). Timer out -> 7 (interrupt). Off ground -> 1.
states.6: Death flight (death_state 6): bullet(); ATTACK ARMED (P2 entry 0).
states.7: Beam end / cooldown (see the generated listing), then back to aiming.

danger.source: param P6 (elem 0xa8, state field 5) set by code every frame of the beam (create_attack_data + set_attack(0, 0))
danger.note: which entry is used when (index expression from a frame counter) and the meaning of x = 310 (beam length: the 3DS capsule end, inferred) are not fully hand-read

darios.targeting: an aim angle (this+0x170 / +0x174) turned toward the nearest target; the shot is triggered by search_target(1) in a cone around it.
darios.projectiles: none (the beam is the enemy's own attack).
darios.meshes: vmt: 0 default, 1 shoot: shoot only in state 5 (beam), default otherwise.

stalfos.summary: Stalfos (Zelda). Walks (Move) and turns at walls; once it sees a fighter it takes a fighting stance and keeps its distance (Fightingwait / Fightingmove / Fightingback, steps), swings a sword combo (state 10 Attack1 variants, 11 Attack2 variants, 12 the end), jump-attacks (13 / 14) and guards (Guardreact, state 6); flinches (19-21) after hits. Its hitboxes are all ACMD (attack.bin): the param attack list only has the death flight.

states.3: Move (walk): kinetic 1, Move (loop). Wall or ledge -> 4 (turn). Each search_interval(0) frames (helper L5f7f8: search_target(0), or the nearest target for index 1) a found fighter -> 5 (fighting stance). A patrol timer this+0x180 (random_range(PSa0.f1 120, PSa0.f2 240)) and random_choice(60, 40) also turn it around (-> 4) at the end of a Move loop. Off ground -> 1.
states.5: Fightingpose (noticed; also the state after damage on the ground, slot 64): -> 9 (attack) when the attack search finds the target in range, else -> 7 at motion end.
states.6: Guardreact (guarding a hit) -> 7, or 16 after a step.
states.7: Fightingwait: the fighting stance; chooses: attack (-> 9) when search_target finds the fighter in range, step forward (15) / back (17), turn (22), approach (8), cancel (18) when the target is lost; ledge checks with check_cliff_distance_lr.
states.9: AttackHold (wind-up) -> 13 (jump attack) or 10 (combo) at motion end.
states.10: Combo swing 1: motion 0 / 5 / 7 / 9 (Attack1 and its aliases; which by this+0x194 = the combo step / strength) -> 11 or 12.
states.11: Combo swing 2: motion 2 / 6 / 8 / 10 (Attack2 and aliases) -> 10 or 12.
states.23: Death flight (death_state 23): DamageStart, bullet(); P2 entry 0 armed.

danger.source: ACMD attack.bin (bone 16 = the sword: 3 spheres at z 19 / 9 / -3, slash effect 2)
danger.note: Attack1 (motion 0): 4 / 3 / 2% angle 55-60 kbg 120 wkb 75 (set knockback) frames 17-21, then 1% angle 40 kbg 125 wkb 70 size 9 (effect 8) frame 21-22; motion 5: same with wkb 40-50; motions 7 / 9 (heavy): 8 / 7 / 6% angle 50 bkb 80 / 70 / 60 frames 17-21; Attack2 (motion 2): 3 / 2 / 1% angle 65 wkb 70 frames 15-19; motion 6: 3 / 2 / 1% angle 50-60 wkb 45-60; motions 8 / 10: 6 / 5 / 4% angle 20 bkb 70 / 60 / 50 frames 14-22
9 / 8 / 8% angle -60 (spike) bkb 120, frames 9-14, the last sphere size 8

danger.source: ACMD init scripts of AttackHold / Fightingmove / Fightingturn and the start of Attack1 / motion 5
danger.note: a 0-damage push box: bone 2 (hip), angle 10, kbg 60-100, wkb 1, size 10-12, z 7 (keeps fighters off; no damage)

stalfos.targeting: search_target / get_nearest_target / check_turn_to_target with P1 (5 entries) and distance checks; see the generated listing for each choice.
stalfos.wiiu: The Wii U's mczakostalfos (kind 0x59) runs this behaviour (step 2a): its 38-index motion set = these indices.

whitebear.summary: White Bear (Ice Climber). Walks; turns at walls and ledges and, every random(60, 120) walk frames, does a special turn; searches with group 1 (box 180 x 140); a fighter found -> QuakeHold, then jumps straight up (QuakeUp / QuakeFall) and lands with a quake (QuakeLanding): camera quake, a ground effect and an absolute hit on the first grounded fighter of the fighter manager (wherever it is); 50 % (then 25 %) chance to jump again, at most 3 quakes, then a 60-frame search cool-down. No contact hitbox while alive; the defeated body flies off with the P2 bullet attack.
whitebear.variations: P0 has one row (variation index * 23 words, var 0).
whitebear.read: enemy_fs.cro (update): create 0x7F420, ctor 0x7F458 (hashsets 0xC8698, damage labels DamageStart..DownWait, Fall), start 0x7E378, initialize 0x7E738, states: 1 0x7E518 / 0x7E7F8, 2 0x7E570 / 0x7E838, 3 0x7E678 / 0x7E950, 4 0x7E5C8 / 0x7E8A8, 5 0x7E620 / 0x7E8FC, 6 0x7EB34 / 0x7F10C, 7 0x7ED14 / 0x7F1F8, 8 0x7EBB4 / 0x7F168, 9 0x7EE74 / 0x7F244, 10 0x7E708 / 0x7EA7C, 11 remove; code.bin Behavior::set_attack_absolute_data 0x7B50AC, hit_attack_absolute 0x7B3D28 (AttackModuleImpl::hit_absolute 0x4CBC48), is_in_view_area 0x9EA804 (CameraModuleImpl::is_clip_in(true)).

states.1: Fall: kinetic 8, attach off, Fall (loop). Update: is_touch(8) -> 2 (interrupt). (No speed test, unlike Kuribo's.)
states.2: Landing: kinetic 0, attach on, Landing. Motion end: the nearest target behind (check_turn_to_target) -> 5, else -> 3.
states.3: Walk: kinetic 1, attach on, Move (loop) at 1; this+0x168 = random_range(P0.f7 60, P0.f8 120), search counter this+0x16c = 0. Update: move(stick (lr, 0)); off the ground -> 1; wall or ledge ahead -> 5; counter++; a search cool-down this+0x178 > 0 is decremented and skips the search while still > 0; when search_interval(1) (60) < counter: counter = 0, search_target(1) (P1[1] {2, 60, 180, 140, 0, 10, 0}) >= 0 -> 6; walk timer-- <= 0 -> 4.
states.4: Special turn: kinetic 0, attach on, SpecialTurn. Motion end: reverse_lr(1, 1), -> 3 (interrupt).
states.5: Turn: kinetic 0, attach on, Turn. Motion end: reverse_lr(1, 1), -> 3 (interrupt).
states.6: Quake hold: kinetic 0, attach on, QuakeHold at P0.f9 = 1.5; quake count this+0x174 = 0. Motion end: is_in_view_area() -> 7, else -> 3.
states.7: Quake jump: energy +0x20 = 0, +0x24 = P0.f10 1.5, +0x28 = 0, +0x2C = P0.f10 1.5, +0x3C = 0.1; KineticEnergy vt+0x74(0x20000004); kinetic 5, attach off, QuakeUp; frames this+0x170 = 0. Update: frames++; the current speed's y <= 0 -> 8.
states.8: Quake fall: energy +0x20 / +0x24 = the current speed (x, y), +0x28 = 0, +0x2C = P0.f12 3, +0x3C = P0.f11 1; vt+0x74(0x20000004); kinetic 5, attach off, QuakeFall. Update: frames++; on the ground: frames < P0.f14 180 -> 9 (interrupt), else -> 2 (interrupt).
states.9: Quake landing: kinetic 0, attach on, QuakeLanding at P0.f13 1 (P0.f16 0.5 when this+0x174 > 0); request_quake(7); set_attack_absolute_data(P6) (only if P6's state word 9 = the current state) and, for the fighter entries in order, the first whose module accessor's +0x24 module vt+0x68 returns 0 (on the ground, inferred) gets hit_attack_absolute(P6 id 0, entry) (AttackModule hit_absolute: the hit applied directly, no hitbox, no range test); request_effect(0x7400000) at the posture position, scaled (P0.f21 2.5, P0.f22 1.7, 1) and turned by the ground angle, request_effect(0x7400001, scale 8); this+0x174++. Motion end: this+0x174 < P0.f17 3 and success_by_percent(P0.f15 50 / 2^(this+0x174 - 1)) -> 7; else cool-down this+0x178 = P0.f18 60, -> 3.
states.10: Death flight (death_state 10): DamageStart at rate 0, bullet(); ATTACK ARMED (P2 entry 0). Kinetic flag 8 -> 11.

danger.source: Behavior::hit_attack_absolute with P6 (InnerEnemyAttackAbsoluteParam: state 9, id 0, part 0, power 10, angle 90, kbg 100, fkb 0, bkb 40, ...) on the first grounded fighter
danger.note: an absolute hit, not a hitbox: the first fighter on the ground (fighter-manager entry order), anywhere on the stage, takes it at the landing. Not ported to the Wii U yet (step 2c).

gordo.summary: Gordo (Kirby). A spiked ball that cannot be defeated: variation 0 stays where it appears (its update steers energy 0 back to its home point), variations 1-3 move back and forth / along a layout path. Contact hitbox all the time.
gordo.variations: 0 in place (set_correct 0); 1 / 2 move along x / y (P0 rows, speed 0.5, set_correct 5), turning on contact; 3 follows its layout path (EnemyGenerator layout data).
gordo.read: enemy_fs.cro (update): create 0x1A470, ctor 0x1A4A8 (no hashsets, no set_damage_motion_label), start 0x19CB0, initialize 0x1A1D8, states: 1 0x1A180 / 0x1A3FC (-> helper 0x65D20), 2 0x1A0B8 / 0x65D1C, 3 remove; slots 64-67 = 0.

states.1: Variation 0: kinetic -1, attach off, Togetoge (loop). Update (helper 0x65D20): KineticModule get_energy(0): vt+0xC(0x17, zeros, zeros, acc), vt+0x10, +0x20 / +0x30 = 0, +0x38 = (100, 100), speed +4 / +8 = (home - position) x 0.5, +0xC = 0, +0x1C = 1: it holds its spawn point.
states.2: Variations 1-3: as 1, the speed along a line (P0 f9 / f10 0.5, reversed on touching ground) or the layout path (get_pos_on_shape).
